name: Cracked Gateway: Root Time
description:
A cracked retro time-sharing gateway is back on the lab network, and its root-only recovery records are missing. Log in with the supplied access details, investigate the gateway, and recover the flag and proof token. The lab network is 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

---

**Access** — SSH `orbit@172.20.0.168`, password `vector-amber-42`

tasks.name: Recover the root records
tasks.description: The gateway's root-only recovery records are still on the host. Investigate the box you can access on the lab network and recover its flag. The lab network is 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Compare the ownership and permission details of unusual executables with the other local footholds you can inspect.
Look for file capabilities across the filesystem; one interpreter has a capability that can change process credentials.
Use that interpreter to set the process UID to 0, then start a shell that preserves its elevated privileges and inspect both root-only records.
